statements.status_notes: The DHI perl APK backports the upstream S_measure_struct overflow guards from https://github.com/Perl/perl5/commit/5f7eb6bbbe0510964e3fb1d6bb691e5445913e55 and https://github.com/Perl/perl5/commit/40754edc72dd3e513d758153c0e2f0215897740e as dhi-cve-2026-57432-pack-struct-overflow.patch. The patched package croaks when a pack/unpack structure size would overflow SSize_t and uses overflow-safe bit/nibble length math. Tracker: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-57432

The DHI perl APK backports the upstream Perl_study_chunk trie overflow guard from https://github.com/Perl/perl5/commit/03f74bbbd3a68350d926ee93d56ee4808c28c4c7 as dhi-cve-2026-13221-regexp-trie-overflow.patch. The patched package skips trie optimization when the start-to-tail delta would overflow a 16-bit field. Tracker: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-13221

Perl is included only as the runtime for the hardened ExifTool used by gitlab-resize-image. CVE-2026-57432 requires an attacker-controlled pack or unpack template; whether any ExifTool path derives a template from image metadata remains under investigation.

Perl is included only as the runtime for the hardened ExifTool used by gitlab-resize-image. CVE-2026-13221 requires compiling an attacker-controlled regular expression with more than 65,535 fixed-string branches; whether any ExifTool path can construct such a pattern from image metadata remains under investigation.
